description: This file defines a custom schema filter for Swagger/OpenAPI documentation generation. It implements the ISchemaFilter interface to modify schemas by removing specific properties, namely 'CorrelationId', from the generated API documentation schemas.

classes.name: CustomSchemaFilters
classes.description: A schema filter implementation that modifies OpenAPI schemas to exclude certain properties.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Modifies the provided OpenApiSchema by removing the 'CorrelationId' property if it exists.
